## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The code change is correct: `--timeout` now defaults to 60, and an explicit value still overrides it. One user-facing doc line is now out of date, so this needs a small fix before merge. No policy files are listed in the manifest.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — The default changes to `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." Could you change that line to say 60 seconds in this PR? — Users who read the README will expect a 30-second timeout and will set their retry or wait budgets around it. Without `--timeout`, their requests now wait up to twice as long.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `tests/test_cli.py:8` now asserts `args.timeout == 60`, so the test would fail if the default changed back. `tests/test_cli.py:13-16` still checks that an explicit `--timeout 12` overrides the default, which supports the PR body's claim that overrides still work.
